grammar.summary: 本课讲述哈丽特姑妈与「理想仆人」贝西的故事，运用了虚拟语气表达对现在情况的假设，用 so...that 结果状语从句描述因果，并通过 before/after 时间状语从句交代事件先后顺序。

points.title: 虚拟语气 (Subjunctive Mood)
points.explanation: 与现在事实相反的虚拟条件句结构为 If + were/did, 主句 would/could + 动词原形。本课用 If she were alive today she would not be able to... 假设姑妈若在世的情况，be 动词用 were，表达与现在事实相反的假设。

examples.en: If she were alive today she would not be able to air her views on her favourite topic of conversation: domestic servants.
examples.cn: 如果她活到今天，她将不能就她热衷的话题「佣人」发表意见了。

points.title: so...that 结果状语从句 (Result Clause)
points.explanation: so + 副词/形容词 + that 从句表示「如此……以至于……」。本课用 so gained...that 描述贝西赢得信任之深以至于被委以重任，用 with such frequency that 描述佣人来去之频繁。

examples.en: During that time she so gained my aunt's confidence that she was put in charge of the domestic staff.
examples.cn: 在此期间，她赢得了姑母的赏识，甚至当上了大管家。

examples.en: She always referred to them as 'the shifting population', for they came and went with such frequency that I never even got a chance to learn their names.
examples.cn: 她称这些佣人叫「流动人口」，因为他们来匆匆，所以我甚至都没有机会知道他们的姓名。

points.title: 时间状语从句 (Time Clauses)
points.explanation: before/after 引导时间状语从句，交代动作的先后关系。本课用 before 描述贝西「扮演完美仆人三年后」才被发现弱点，用 after 描述姑妈「离开一周后」突然回来，推动情节转折。

examples.en: She acted the role of the perfect servant for three years before Aunt Harriet discovered her 'little weakness'.
examples.cn: 她担任「理想仆人」角色3年之后，哈丽特终于发现她有「小小的弱点」。

examples.en: After being absent from the Gables for a week, my aunt unexpectedly returned one afternoon with a party of guests and instructed Bessie to prepare dinner.
examples.cn: 一次，姑妈有一个星期没在「山墙庄园」住。一天下午，她出其不意地回来了，带来一大批客人，吩咐贝西准备晚饭。

exercises.q: If she ______ alive today she would not be able to air her views on her favourite topic of conversation: domestic servants.
During that time she ______ gained my aunt's confidence that she was put in charge of the domestic staff.
She acted the role of the perfect servant for three years ______ Aunt Harriet discovered her 'little weakness'.
用虚拟语气填空：If she were alive today she ______ not be able to air her views on her favourite topic of conversation.（填入与虚拟主句搭配的情态动词）
